evidence: Skill procedure (quality-checks.md:33-35): ask what the smallest submission satisfying the brief would be; defect if a static page, single CRUD screen or mock satisfies it. Smallest conforming build here is a full product: instruction.md:3 says 'there is no starter app to finish', environment/Dockerfile:17-23 leaves /app with only .gitkeep, and seed_data.json:2-3 has no snippets or implementation. The brief requires a self-implemented editing surface with no textarea/input/contenteditable or ready-made editor (ui.md:3), multi-caret editing with atomic undo (ui.md:9), find/replace, token colouring and formatting (ui.md:11-15), an isolated preview with a five-second budget, Stop and last-good restore (behaviour.md:3-7, security.md:3-5), and SQLite-backed revisioned snippets with stale-save refusal, live cross-tab refresh and restart survival (behaviour.md:9-13, integration.md:7-9). The reward enforces that: gates/render/judge.toml:23 needs real typing plus a recomputed sum on a second Run, and gates/render/prompt.md:5 fails 'a static shell whose editor cannot be typed into or whose Run does nothing'; gates/constraints/judge.toml:23 fails a textarea/contenteditable or library editor (the trivial route), and judge.toml:32 requires the saved record to survive clearing browser storage, excluding a browser-only mock. score.py:41-48 zeroes the reward unless both gates pass and functional exceeds the 0.05 floor (scoring.toml:10-11); the 40 functional criteria total weight 56.5, so the floor needs more than 2.825 weight of working behaviour, i.e. at least two to three real features. Weak app tried: a static or mock page, or a textarea playground, fails the gates and earns 0. A thin real app (own DOM editor with typing only, iframe Run with console capture, SQLite save) passes the gates and can clear the floor through cw_html_preview, cw_console_levels_in_order and cw_save_reload_restart (3.5/56.5 = 0.062), earning a small shaped reward; that app is already genuine build work, not a stub, so this is the intended shaped gradient rather than a defect. Conforming alternative tried: a canvas- or SVG-drawn editor is accepted by the constraints gate ('ordinary non-editable elements, canvas or SVG') and app_context.md:25, so real builds are not excluded. Not measured: no configured-judge run on a stub or weak app exists (raw-evidence-index.json limitations: 'Oracle reward and reward discrimination are not measured'), so the judge's actual rejection of a stub is derived from the criteria text, not observed.
